newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel orders Hebron shops closed after shooting.
newsitem.headline: Israel orders Hebron shops closed after shooting.

text.p: Israel's army ordered the closure of Palestinian shops in the West Bank city of Hebron on Thursday after shots were fired overnight at a building housing Jewish settlers.

The army said Major-General Uzi Dayan also issued orders for roadblocks to remain in place around the volatile city and that soldiers should be stationed along the dividing line between Israeli and Palestinian areas.
Witnesses and Israeli military sources said no one was hurt when the shots were fired late on Wednesday but at least one bullet hit an outer wall of the Jewish settler enclave of Beit Hadassah.
Israel controls 20 percent of the city under a peace deal struck with the Palestine Liberation Organisation (PLO). In January, Israel handed over the remaining 80 percent to Palestinian self-rule.

A Jewish woman faces up to 26 years in prison for putting up posters in Hebron last month portraying the Moslem Prophet Mohammad as a pig. The posters sparked a wave of unrest in the city where 400 Jews live amid 100,000 Arabs.
